summary: A 9-page interactive storybook for ages 9-13 about the NASA hardware left on the Moon, Mars and in deep space - the Apollo 17 rover, Moon mirrors, Opportunity, Ingenuity and the Voyagers - with a laser demo, timeline slider and quiz.
details:
NASA has left hardware across the solar system since the 1960s, and most people never hear what happened to it. Abandoned but not Forgotten tells that story as a 9-page interactive storybook for readers aged 9-13. Six chapters follow the Apollo 17 rover, the Moon mirrors that still answer lasers, the small things left on the Moon, Opportunity, Ingenuity and the Voyagers. Each chapter follows the same beats - meet it, its job, goodbye, what it still tells us - so young readers can follow every story. Readers can fire a laser at the Moon mirrors, slide through Opportunity's 5,111-sol journey, and test themselves with a quiz. Built as a single HTML page with CSS and JavaScript for the interactions. Every fact is checked against the NASA sources listed in the book.

NASA Data Used:

1. NASA Science — Voyager Frequently Asked Questions — Facts about Voyager 1 and 2 — that they are still travelling, now in interstellar space, and still sending data. Source: NASA Science (science.nasa.gov). https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/frequently-asked-questions/

2. NASA Science — 10 Things: Going Interstellar — Facts about the interstellar journey — Voyager 1 & 2 and Pioneer 10 leaving the Solar System, and what they still tell us. Source: NASA Science (science.nasa.gov). https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/10-things-going-interstellar/

Add more chapters as missions end, translate the storybook into more languages (starting with Malayalam) for school readers in Kerala, add a teacher guide and a print version for classrooms, and add audio narration so younger readers can listen along.
